project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-211 In-repo topology discipline (import-linter contract) — P2-25
description: Cut from origin/main @ 9dd4c848a — re-verify every path/anchor by grep, they drift. SCOPE = 3 stories: US-001 the import-linter (grimp) independence contract that LOCKS the healthy 3.0% lateral coupling (thesis T2), US-002 delete the 7 dead mem0-residue files the PRD-187 un-split left behind, US-003 verify the /api/tasks-stays-gone guard (no-op — already deleted in PRD-192 S6). THIS IS MOSTLY ADDITIVE + SUBTRACTION, LOW RISK — the contract is authored to be GREEN on current main (it ratchets from the measured state; it does NOT demand a refactor). WHY: T2 measured the platform is a healthy modular monolith (only 3.0% true feature-to-feature coupling; 80.5% is the shared kernel) and the verdict is 'stay a monolith, harden the boundaries in-repo' — a claim until it is ENFORCED. This contract makes a new lateral edge fail loud in CI. CROSS-PRD: modules.learning + modules.evaluation are in the contract's module list AND are PRD-184 S1 kill targets — they exist on THIS branch's base so list them; when PRD-184 merges first, drop them on rebase (a contract cannot reference a deleted package). Complements (does NOT duplicate) the PRD-195/207 route-manifest sweep — that guards ROUTES, this guards module IMPORT coupling. BINDING: no os.getenv (the contract is a static config file); NO backward-compat shim (delete the 7 residue files, no _legacy); PURE tests; NEVER 'git add -A'/'git add .' (node_modules is untracked and NOT gitignored — stage only specific paths); never 'git stash -u'. Full spec: docs/PRDS/PRD-211-PHASE2-WAVE-4-TOPOLOGY-DISCIPLINE.md.

userStories.title: The import-linter independence contract (lock the 3.0% lateral coupling)
userStories.description: Add `import-linter` (pulls grimp; light pure-Python) pinned in `orchestrator/requirements.txt`; a contract config at `orchestrator/.importlinter` (an `independence` contract over the ~18 feature modules under orchestrator/modules/*, with modules.tools + api EXCLUDED as the permitted routing layer and the shared kernel implicitly allowed); and a dedicated non-required CI lane `.github/workflows/import-linter.yml` (mirror the existing check-shopify-isolation.yml). RE-TRACE the current known-good lateral edges on THIS branch by running/reading grimp and carry them as explicit `ignore_imports` so the contract is GREEN on the branch tip (ratchet from the measured state — forbid the NEXT new lateral edge, do not demand a refactor). Do NOT take the edge list from the PRD doc as final — enumerate it live. Rule in words: 'no feature module may import another feature module except through modules/tools or api.'
